digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criteria routing and impact grading
propositions: G7 routing entry must shift from default_posture 'advisory' at block_threshold 0.95 to default_posture 'blocking' at block_threshold 0.85 to enable plan-review blocking on high-confidence findings (348 historical findings show 0 clearly-incorrect at priority >= 0.85).

G7 blocking admitts both contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor-kind grades (both hard-floor impact at 0.85 per ADR 0054), while incomplete_enumeration contributions at 0.55 cannot reach the 0.85 bar and remain advisory.

G7 rubric must add four rule sentences: abstain-with-coverage on unresolvable parent (never emit finding), closed-parent final-state + sibling-handoff scoping, one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause dedup, and floor-kind guidance to disambiguate genuine contradictions and required omissions from cosmetic wording mismatches.

Real Pass-3 wrapper with real impact_plan grading produces the intended blocking behavior: contradicts_reality and omits_required_site findings block at validity >= 0.85, incomplete_enumeration findings stay advisory at priority 0.55, and boundary cases respect validity guards.
Pinned routing table, blocking-set unions (via new G7_BLOCKING constant), approved-blocking set, and test posture assertions must all reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking').

No per-grade Pass-3 gating or kernel machinery changes are required; kind scoping is enforced entirely by existing plan-v4 divergence grading and rubric guidance (reject alternative requiring new cross-gate machinery).
